  getter g : Array(Array(T))
  forward_missing_to g

  def initialize(@n)
    @g = Array.new(n){ [] of T }
  end

  def tsort
    ans = [] of T
    ind = Array.new(n,0)
    n.times do |i|
      g[i].each do |j|
        ind[j] += 1
      end
    end
    q = [] of T
    n.times do |i|
      q << i if ind[i].zero?
    end
    while q.size > 0
      i = q.shift
      ans << i
      g[i].each do |j|
        ind[j] -= 1
        q << j if ind[j].zero?
      end
    end
    ans
  end
end

solve :: Int -> Int -> [(Int,Int)] -> [Int]
solve bN bM lstAB = map (snd . theFunc) [1..bN]
  where
    
  parent :: V.Vector [Int]
  parent = V.create $ do
    vec <- VM.replicate (bN+1) []
    forM lstAB $ \(a,b) -> do
      VM.modify vec (a:) b
    return vec

  mf :: Monad m => (Int -> m (Int,Int)) -> Int -> m (Int,Int)
  mf rc i = do
    case (parent V.! i) of
      [] -> return (0, 0)
      ps -> do
        let f x = (,x) <$> rc x
        ((n, _), p) <- maximumM (map f ps)
        return (n+1, p)

  theMemo = memovec id (bN+1) mf [1..bN]
  theFunc = func_memo id theMemo

lzFold' :: Monad m => (b -> a -> b) -> b -> [m a] -> m b
lzFold' op b0 = sub b0 where
  sub !acc [] = return acc
  sub !acc (ma:mas) = ma >>= (\a -> sub (op acc a) mas)

lzFold1' :: Monad m => (a -> a -> a) -> [m a] -> m a
lzFold1' op (ma:mas) = ma >>= flip (lzFold' op) mas

maximumM :: (Monad m, Ord a) => [m a] -> m a
maximumM = lzFold1' max

memovec :: forall a d. (VU.Unbox a, Show a, Show d) =>
           (d -> Int) -> Int -> 
           (forall m. Monad m => (d -> m a) -> d -> m a) ->
           [d] -> VU.Vector a
memovec encode size mf ds = VU.create $ do
  vec <- VUM.new size
  flags <- VUM.replicate size False
  mapM_ (calc vec flags) ds
  return vec
  where
    calc vec flags d = do
      fv <- VUM.read flags (encode d)
      if fv then VUM.read vec (encode d)
        else do
        val <- mf (calc vec flags) d
        VUM.write vec   (encode d) val
        VUM.write flags (encode d) True
        return val

func_memo :: VU.Unbox a => (d->Int) -> VU.Vector a -> d -> a
func_memo encode vecV d = vecV VU.! (encode d)

solve :: Int -> [(Int, Int)] -> [Int]
solve n abs = map f [1..n]
  where
    adjList = toAdjList abs
    sorted = IntMap.fromList $ zip (topologocalSort adjList) [1..]
    revDirAdjList = reverseDirection adjList
    f :: Int -> Int
    f i | IntMap.notMember i revDirAdjList = 0
        | otherwise = if length candidates == 1
                      then head candidates
                      else maximumBy (\x y -> compare (sorted IntMap.! x) (sorted IntMap.! y)) candidates
          where
            candidates = revDirAdjList IntMap.! i 


type AdjList = IntMap.IntMap [Int]

toAdjList :: [(Int, Int)] -> AdjList
toAdjList = foldr insert IntMap.empty 
  where
    insert :: (Int, Int) -> AdjList -> AdjList
    insert (a, b) adjList = IntMap.insertWith (++) a [b] adjList

topologocalSort :: AdjList -> [Int]
topologocalSort as = reverse . dfs nodes [] IntSet.empty $ reverseDirection as
  where
    nodes = nub $ (IntMap.keys as) ++ join (IntMap.elems as)

dfs :: [Int] -> [Int] -> IntSet.IntSet -> AdjList -> [Int]
dfs [] visiteds _ _ = visiteds
dfs (s:ss) visiteds vset adjList
  | IntSet.member s vset = dfs ss visiteds vset adjList -- 訪問済のノード
  | IntMap.notMember s adjList = dfs ss (s:visiteds) newset adjList -- 入次数0のノード
  | null unvisiteds = dfs ss (s:visiteds) newset adjList -- 入字数0ではないが、上流が全て探索済みのノード
  | otherwise = dfs ((head unvisiteds):s:ss) visiteds vset adjList
    where
      unvisiteds = (adjList IntMap.! s) \\ visiteds
      newset = IntSet.insert s vset

-- Reverse direction of directed graph
reverseDirection :: AdjList -> AdjList
reverseDirection = IntMap.foldrWithKey f IntMap.empty
  where
    f :: Int -> [Int] -> AdjList -> AdjList
    f s gs adjList = foldr (\g al-> IntMap.insertWith (++) g [s] al) adjList gs

solve ::Int -> [[Int]] -> [Int]
solve n = map snd . sortBy (comparing fst) . check 0 . build
    where
        build es = (g, sh)
            where
                g = M.fromDistinctAscList $ zipWith zf ins cs
                sh = push (Edge 0 0 0 . fst $ minimumBy (comparing snd) ins) empty 
                zf (i, c) (_, p) = (i, Node c p)
                ins = M.toAscList $ foldl' ff0 (acc0 0) es
                cs = M.toAscList $ foldl' ff1 (acc0 []) es
                acc0 = M.fromDistinctAscList . zip [1..n] . repeat 
                ff0 acc [a, b] = M.update (return . succ) b acc
                ff1 acc [a, b] = M.update (return . (b :)) a acc

        check c (g, pop -> Just (Edge w x y z, xs))
            | c == n = []
            | otherwise = (z, y) : check (c + 1) (g, ys)
            where
                ys = foldl' ff xs . children $ g M.! z
                ff acc i = push (Edge (w + 1) (pc $ g M.! i) z i) acc 
        check _ _ = []

data Node = Node {pc :: Int, children :: [Int]}
    deriving (Show, Eq)

data Edge = Edge {h :: Int, ic :: Int, u :: Int, v :: Int}
    deriving (Show, Eq)

instance Ord Edge where
    compare lhs rhs = comparing h rhs lhs `mappend` comparing ic lhs rhs

data Heap a = E | T Int a (Heap a) (Heap a)
    deriving (Show)
    
empty :: Heap a 
empty = E

null :: Heap a -> Bool 
null E = True
null _ = False

merge :: (Ord a) => Heap a -> Heap a -> Heap a
merge lh@(T _ lv la lb) rh@(T _ rv ra rb)
    | lv <= rv = makeT lv la $ merge lb rh
    | otherwise = makeT rv ra $ merge lh rb
    where
        makeT v a b
            | rank a >= rank b = T (rank b + 1) v a b
            | otherwise = T (rank a + 1) v b a
        rank (T r _ _ _) = r
        rank _ = 0
        
merge lh E = lh
merge _ rh = rh

push :: (Ord a) => a -> Heap a -> Heap a
push x = merge (T 1 x E E)

pop :: (Ord a) => Heap a -> Maybe (a, Heap a) 
pop (T _ x a b) = Just (x, merge a b)
pop _ = Nothing

fromList :: (Ord a) => [a] -> Heap a
fromList = br . fmap (\x -> T 1 x E E)
    where
        build (x : y : zs) = merge x y : build zs
        build xs = xs
        br [x] = x
        br xs = br $ build xs

(defmacro with-memoizing (cache-attribs def-form)
  (let* ((cache-attribs (if (atom cache-attribs) (list cache-attribs) cache-attribs))
         (cache-type (first cache-attribs))
         (dimensions-with-* (when (eql cache-type :array) (second cache-attribs)))
         (dimensions (remove '* dimensions-with-*))
         (rank (length dimensions))
         (rest-attribs (ecase cache-type
                         (:hash-table (cdr cache-attribs))
                         (:array (cddr cache-attribs))))
         (key (prog1 (getf rest-attribs :key) (remf rest-attribs :key)))
         (cache-form (case cache-type
                       (:hash-table `(make-hash-table ,@rest-attribs))
                       (:array `(make-array ',dimensions ,@rest-attribs))))
         (initial-element (when (eql cache-type :array)
                            (assert (member :initial-element rest-attribs))
                            (getf rest-attribs :initial-element))))
    (let ((cache (gensym))
          (value (gensym))
	  (present-p (gensym))
          (name-alias (gensym))
	  (args-lst (gensym))
          (indices (loop repeat rank collect (gensym))))
      (labels ((make-cache-check-form (cache-type args)
                 (case cache-type
                   (:hash-table
                    `(let ((,args-lst (funcall ,(or key #'list) ,@args)))
                       (multiple-value-bind (,value ,present-p)
                           (gethash ,args-lst ,cache)
                         (if ,present-p
                             ,value
                             (setf (gethash ,args-lst ,cache)
                                   (,name-alias ,@args))))))
                   (:array
                    (let ((memoized-args (loop for dimension in dimensions-with-*
                                               for arg in args
                                               unless (eql dimension '*)
                                               collect arg)))
                      (if key
                          `(multiple-value-bind ,indices
                               (funcall ,key ,@memoized-args)
                             (let ((,value (aref ,cache ,@indices)))
                               (if (eql ,initial-element ,value)
                                   (setf (aref ,cache ,@indices)
                                         (,name-alias ,@args))
                                   ,value)))
                          `(let ((,value (aref ,cache ,@memoized-args)))
                             (if (eql ,initial-element ,value)
                                 (setf (aref ,cache ,@memoized-args)
                                       (,name-alias ,@args))
                                 ,value)))))))
               (make-reset-form (cache-type)
                 (case cache-type
                   (:hash-table `(setf ,cache (make-hash-table ,@rest-attribs)))
                   (:array `(prog1 nil
                              (fill (array-storage-vector ,cache) ,initial-element)))))
               (make-reset-name (name)
                 (intern (format nil "RESET-~A" (symbol-name name))))
               (extract-declarations (body)
                 (remove-if-not (lambda (form) (eql 'declare (car form))) body)))
        (ecase (car def-form)
          ((defun)
           (destructuring-bind (_ name args &body body) def-form
             (declare (ignore _))
             `(let ((,cache ,cache-form))
                (defun ,(make-reset-name name) () ,(make-reset-form cache-type))
                (defun ,name ,args
                  (labels ((,name-alias ,args ,@body))
                    (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                    ,@(extract-declarations body)
                    ,(make-cache-check-form cache-type args))))))
          ((nlet)
           (destructuring-bind (_ name bindings &body body) def-form
             (declare (ignore _))
             `(let ((,cache ,cache-form))
                (nlet ,name ,bindings
                      ,(let ((args (mapcar (lambda (x) (if (atom x) x (car x))) bindings)))
                         `(labels ((,name-alias ,args ,@body))
                            (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                            ,@(extract-declarations body)
                            ,(make-cache-check-form cache-type args)))))))
          ((labels flet)
           (destructuring-bind (_ definitions &body labels-body) def-form
             (declare (ignore _))
             (destructuring-bind (name args &body body) (car definitions)
               `(let ((,cache ,cache-form))
                  (,(car def-form)
                   ((,(make-reset-name name) () ,(make-reset-form cache-type))
                    (,name ,args
                           (labels ((,name-alias ,args ,@body))
                             (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                             ,@(extract-declarations body)
                             ,(make-cache-check-form cache-type args)))
                    ,@(cdr definitions))
                   (declare (ignorable #',(make-reset-name name)))
                   ,@labels-body))))))))))

(defun topological-sort (graph)
  "Returns a vector of all the vertices sorted in topological order. This
function signals CYCLE-DETECTED-ERROR when it detects a cycle.

GRAPH := vector of adjacency lists."
  (declare (vector graph))
  (let* ((n (length graph))
         (tmp-marked (make-array n :element-type 'bit :initial-element 0))
         (marked (make-array n :element-type 'bit :initial-element 0))

;; Hauptteil
(defun solve (graph root)
  (declare #.OPT)
  (let* ((n (length graph))
         (cost-table (make-array n :element-type 'uint32 :initial-element 0))
         (parents-table (make-array n :element-type 'int32 :initial-element -1)))
    (setf (aref cost-table root) 0)
    (dotimes (i n)
      (nlet recurse ((graph graph))
        (unless (null graph)
          (let* ((pair (car graph))
                 (a (car pair))
                 (b (cdr pair)))
            (when (> (+ (aref cost-table a) 1) (aref cost-table b))
              (setf (aref cost-table b) (+ (aref cost-table a) 1))
              (setf (aref parents-table b) a))
            (recurse (cdr graph))))))
    parents-table))

(defun main ()
  (declare #.OPT)
  (let* ((n (read))
         (m (read))
         (graph (make-array n :element-type 'list :initial-element nil))
         (rev-graph (make-array n :element-type 'list :initial-element nil))
         (marked (make-array n :element-type 'boolean :initial-element nil))
         sorted
         (out (make-string-output-stream :element-type 'base-char)))
    (declare (uint32 n m))
    (dotimes (i (+ n -1 m))
      (split-ints-bind (a b) (buffered-read-line 20)
        (declare (uint32 a b))
        (push (- b 1) (aref graph (- a 1)))
        (push (- a 1) (aref rev-graph (- b 1)))))
    (dotimes (src n)
      (nlet recurse ((node src))
        (unless (aref marked node)
          (setf (aref marked node) t)
          (dolist (next (aref graph node))
            (recurse next))
          (push node sorted))))
    (let ((rev-sorted (make-array n :element-type 'uint32)))
      (loop for node in sorted
            for idx below n
            do (setf (aref rev-sorted node) idx))
      (dotimes (i n (write-string (get-output-stream-string out)))
        (if (null (aref rev-graph i))
            (println 0 out)
            (println (1+ (the uint32
                              (reduce (lambda (x y)
                                        (if (< (aref rev-sorted x)
                                               (aref rev-sorted y))
                                            y x))
                                      (aref rev-graph i))))
                     out))))))

class Graph

  attr_accessor :g, :n

  def initialize(n)
    @n = n
    @g = Array.new(n){ [] }
  end

  def [](i); g[i]; end
  def []=(i,v); g[i]=v; end

  def tsort_each_node
    n.times do |i|
      yield i
    end
  end

  def tsort_each_child(i)
    g[i].each do |j|
      yield j
    end
  end
end

  dim -= 1

def dfs(e,reve)
	stack = []
	reve.select{|k,v| v.size == 0}.each{|k,v|
		stack << k
	}
	# stack = reve.select{|a| a[1].size == 0}.to_a # not stack
	revnum = [0] + reve.map{|k,v| v.size} # incoming nodes numbers
	# p revnum
	# p stack
	result = []
	while(!stack.empty?)
		v = stack.pop
		result.push(v)
		# p "e #{e}"
		# p "v #{v}"
		# p "e[v] #{e[v]}"
		chs = e[v]
		chs.each{|ch|
			# p "ch #{ch}"
			# p "revnum[ch] #{revnum[ch]}"
			revnum[ch] -= 1
			# p "revnum[ch] reduced to #{revnum[ch]}"
			if(revnum[ch] == 0)
				result.push(ch)
				# p "children of #{ch} pushed"
				# p "#{e[ch]}"
				# p "stack #{stack}"
				stack += e[ch]
			end
		}
	end
	result
end

def restore_tree(graph_hash,n)
  next_root = ((1..n).to_a - graph_hash.keys)[0]
  graph_hash[next_root] = [0]
  while(graph_hash.values.flatten.length > n)
    tmp_next_root = 0
    graph_hash.each do |k,v|
      graph_hash[k] = v - [next_root] if v.length >= 2
      tmp_next_root = k if v == [next_root]
    end
    next_root = tmp_next_root
  end
  graph_hash
end

  result = quote do: ()
  when NimMinor <= 13:

type UnselectableTypeError = object of Exception
template input*(typ: typedesc; count: Natural = 0): untyped =
  let line = stdin.readLine.split
  when count == 0:
    when typ is int:    line.map(parseInt)
    elif typ is float:  line.map(parseFloat)
    elif typ is string: line
    else: raise newException(UnselectableTypeError, "You selected a type other than int, float or string")
  else:
    when typ is int:    line.map(parseInt).unpack(count)
    elif typ is float:  line.map(parseFloat).unpack(count)
    elif typ is string: line.unpack(count)
    else: raise newException(UnselectableTypeError, "You selected a type other than int, float or string")

template inputs*(typ: typedesc; count = 0; rows = 1): untyped =
  (1..rows).mapIt(input(typ, count))

from algorithm import SortOrder

type PairNode[T] = ref object
  element: T
  leftChild: PairNode[T]
  nextSibling: PairNode[T]
  prev: PairNode[T]

proc newPairNode[T](element: T): PairNode[T] =
  new result
  result.element = element



type PairingHeap[T] = ref object
  root: PairNode[T]
  cmp: proc (x, y: T): int

proc newPairingHeap*[T](order = SortOrder.Ascending): PairingHeap[T] =
  new result
  result.root = nil
  if order == Ascending:
    result.cmp = system.cmp
  else:
    result.cmp = proc (x, y: T): int = -system.cmp(x, y)

proc newPairingHeap*[T](cmp: proc (x, y: T): int {.closure.}): PairingHeap[T] =
  new result
  result.root = nil
  result.cmp = cmp

proc compareAndLink[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; first, second: var PairNode[T]) =
  if second.isNil:
    return

  if this.cmp(first.element, second.element) > 0:
    second.prev = first.prev
    first.prev = second
    first.nextSibling = second.leftChild
    if not first.nextSibling.isNil:
      first.nextSibling.prev = first
    second.leftChild = first
    first = second
  else:
    second.prev = first
    first.nextSibling = second.nextSibling
    if not first.nextSibling.isNil:
      first.nextSibling.prev = first
    second.nextSibling = first.leftChild
    if not second.nextSibling.isNil:
      second.nextSibling.prev = second
    first.leftChild = second

proc isEmpty[T](this: PairingHeap[T]): bool =
  this.root.isNil

proc insert*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; value: T): PairNode[T] {.discardable.} =
  result = newPairNode(value)
  if this.isEmpty:
    this.root = result
  else:
    this.compareAndLink(this.root, result)

proc findMin*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]): T =
  this.root.element

proc combineSiblings[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; firstSibling: var PairNode[T]): PairNode[T] =
  if firstSibling.nextSibling.isNil:
    return firstSibling

  var
    treeArray {.global.} = newSeq[PairNode[T]](5)
    numOfSiblings = 0
  while not firstSibling.isNil:
    if numOfSiblings == treeArray.len:
      treeArray.setLen(numOfSiblings * 2)
    treeArray[numOfSiblings] = firstSibling
    firstSibling.prev.nextSibling = nil
    firstSibling = firstSibling.nextSibling
    numOfSiblings.inc

  if numOfSiblings == treeArray.len:
    treeArray.setLen(numOfSiblings + 1)
  treeArray[numOfSiblings] = nil

  for i in countup(0, numOfSiblings - 2, 2):
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[i], treeArray[i + 1])

  if numOfSiblings mod 2 == 1:
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[numOfSiblings - 3], treeArray[numOfSiblings - 1])

  for j in countdown(numOfSiblings - numOfSiblings mod 2 - 2, 2, 2):
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[j - 2], treeArray[j])

  return treeArray[0]

proc deleteMinHelper[T](this: PairingHeap[T]) =
  if this.root.leftChild.isNil:
    this.root = nil
  else:
    this.root = this.combineSiblings(this.root.leftChild)

proc deleteMin*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]): T =
  if this.isEmpty:
    raise newException(ResourceExhaustedError, "The heap is empty")
  result = this.findMin
  this.deleteMinHelper

proc decrease*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; p: PairNode; newValue: T) =
  if p.element < newValue:
    return
  p.element = newValue

  if p != this.root:
    if not p.nextSibling.isNil:
      p.nextSibling.prev = p.prev

    if p.prev.leftChild == p:
      p.prev.leftChild = p.nextSibling
    else:
      p.prev.nextSibling = p.nextSibling
      p.nextSibling = nil
      compareAndLink(this.root, p)



type PriorityQueue*[T] = ref object
  heap: PairingHeap[T]
  size: Natural

proc newPriorityQueue*[T](order = SortOrder.Ascending): PriorityQueue[T] =
  new result
  result.heap = newPairingHeap[T](order)

proc newPriorityQueue*[T](cmp: proc (x, y: T): int): PriorityQueue[T] =
  new result
  result.heap = newPairingHeap[T](cmp)

proc isEmpty*[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): bool =
  this.heap.isEmpty

proc size*[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): Natural =
  this.size

proc top*[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  this.heap.findMin

proc push*[T](this: var PriorityQueue[T]; value: T) =
  this.heap.insert(value)
  this.size.inc

proc pop*[T](this: var PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  result = this.heap.deleteMin
  this.size.dec

proc meld*[T](this, other: var PriorityQueue[T]): PriorityQueue[T] {.discardable.} =
  ## The order of Two priority queues must be same.
  if other.isEmpty:
    return this
  if this.isEmpty:
    swap(this, other)
    return this

  this.heap.compareAndLink(this.heap.root, other.heap.root)
  this.size += other.size
  other.heap.root = nil
  other.size = 0
  return this

proc `$`[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): string =
  if this.isEmpty: return "[]"

  var copy = newPriorityQueue[T]()
  copy.deepCopy(this)
  result = "[" & $copy.pop
  while not copy.isEmpty:
    result.add(" " & $copy.pop)
  result.add("]")

  result.n = Natural(0)
  result.cmp = cmp

proc len[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): Natural =
  this.n

proc enqueue[T](this: var PriorityQueue[T], e: T) =
  this.n += 1
  this.a.add(e)
  var i = this.a.len() - 1
  while i > 1 and this.cmp(this.a[i], this.a[i div 2]):
    swap(this.a[i], this.a[i div 2])
    i = i div 2

proc dequeue[T](this: var PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  this.n -= 1
  result = this.a[1]
  this.a[1] = this.a.pop()
  var i = 1
  while i < this.a.len():
    var j = i
    if i * 2 < this.a.len() and this.cmp(this.a[i * 2], this.a[j]):
      j = i * 2
    if i * 2 + 1 < this.a.len() and this.cmp(this.a[i * 2 + 1], this.a[j]):
      j = i * 2 + 1
    if i == j:
      break
    swap(this.a[i], this.a[j])
    i = j

proc front[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  this.a[1]

type
  Deque*[T] = object
    ## A double-ended queue backed with a ringed seq buffer.
    data: seq[T]
    head, tail, count, mask: int

proc initDeque*[T](initialSize: int = 4): Deque[T] =
  ## Create a new deque.
  ## Optionally, the initial capacity can be reserved via `initialSize` as a
  ## performance optimization. The length of a newly created deque will still
  ## be 0.
  ##
  ## `initialSize` needs to be a power of two. If you need to accept runtime
  ## values for this you could use the ``nextPowerOfTwo`` proc from the
  ## `math <math.html>`_ module.
  assert isPowerOfTwo(initialSize)
  result.mask = initialSize-1
  newSeq(result.data, initialSize)

proc len*[T](deq: Deque[T]): int {.inline.} =
  ## Return the number of elements of `deq`.
  result = deq.count

template emptyCheck(deq) =
  # Bounds check for the regular deque access.
  when compileOption("boundChecks"):
    if unlikely(deq.count < 1):
      raise newException(IndexError, "Empty deque.")

template xBoundsCheck(deq, i) =
  # Bounds check for the array like accesses.
  when compileOption("boundChecks"):  # d:release should disable this.
    if unlikely(i >= deq.count):  # x < deq.low is taken care by the Natural parameter
      raise newException(IndexError,
                         "Out of bounds: " & $i & " > " & $(deq.count - 1))

proc `[]`*[T](deq: Deque[T], i: Natural) : T {.inline.} =
  ## Access the i-th element of `deq` by order from first to last.
  ## deq[0] is the first, deq[^1] is the last.
  xBoundsCheck(deq, i)
  return deq.data[(deq.head + i) and deq.mask]

proc `[]`*[T](deq: var Deque[T], i: Natural): var T {.inline.} =
  ## Access the i-th element of `deq` and returns a mutable
  ## reference to it.
  xBoundsCheck(deq, i)
  return deq.data[(deq.head + i) and deq.mask]

proc `[]=`* [T] (deq: var Deque[T], i: Natural, val : T) {.inline.} =
  ## Change the i-th element of `deq`.
  xBoundsCheck(deq, i)
  deq.data[(deq.head + i) and deq.mask] = val

iterator items*[T](deq: Deque[T]): T =
  ## Yield every element of `deq`.
  var i = deq.head
  for c in 0 ..< deq.count:
    yield deq.data[i]
    i = (i + 1) and deq.mask

iterator mitems*[T](deq: var Deque[T]): var T =
  ## Yield every element of `deq`.
  var i = deq.head
  for c in 0 ..< deq.count:
    yield deq.data[i]
    i = (i + 1) and deq.mask

iterator pairs*[T](deq: Deque[T]): tuple[key: int, val: T] =
  ## Yield every (position, value) of `deq`.
  var i = deq.head
  for c in 0 ..< deq.count:
    yield (c, deq.data[i])
    i = (i + 1) and deq.mask

proc contains*[T](deq: Deque[T], item: T): bool {.inline.} =
  ## Return true if `item` is in `deq` or false if not found. Usually used
  ## via the ``in`` operator. It is the equivalent of ``deq.find(item) >= 0``.
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   if x in q:
  ##     assert q.contains x
  for e in deq:
    if e == item: return true
  return false

proc expandIfNeeded[T](deq: var Deque[T]) =
  var cap = deq.mask + 1
  if unlikely(deq.count >= cap):
    var n = newSeq[T](cap * 2)
    for i, x in pairs(deq):  # don't use copyMem because the GC and because it's slower.
      shallowCopy(n[i], x)
    shallowCopy(deq.data, n)
    deq.mask = cap * 2 - 1
    deq.tail = deq.count
    deq.head = 0

proc addFirst*[T](deq: var Deque[T], item: T) =
  ## Add an `item` to the beginning of the `deq`.
  expandIfNeeded(deq)
  inc deq.count
  deq.head = (deq.head - 1) and deq.mask
  deq.data[deq.head] = item

proc addLast*[T](deq: var Deque[T], item: T) =
  ## Add an `item` to the end of the `deq`.
  expandIfNeeded(deq)
  inc deq.count
  deq.data[deq.tail] = item
  deq.tail = (deq.tail + 1) and deq.mask

proc peekFirst*[T](deq: Deque[T]): T {.inline.}=
  ## Returns the first element of `deq`, but does not remove it from the deque.
  emptyCheck(deq)
  result = deq.data[deq.head]

proc peekLast*[T](deq: Deque[T]): T {.inline.} =
  ## Returns the last element of `deq`, but does not remove it from the deque.
  emptyCheck(deq)
  result = deq.data[(deq.tail - 1) and deq.mask]

template destroy(x: untyped) =
  reset(x)

proc popFirst*[T](deq: var Deque[T]): T {.inline, discardable.} =
  ## Remove and returns the first element of the `deq`.
  emptyCheck(deq)
  dec deq.count
  result = deq.data[deq.head]
  destroy(deq.data[deq.head])
  deq.head = (deq.head + 1) and deq.mask

proc popLast*[T](deq: var Deque[T]): T {.inline, discardable.} =
  ## Remove and returns the last element of the `deq`.
  emptyCheck(deq)
  dec deq.count
  deq.tail = (deq.tail - 1) and deq.mask
  result = deq.data[deq.tail]
  destroy(deq.data[deq.tail])

proc clear*[T](deq: var Deque[T]) {.inline.} =
  ## Resets the deque so that it is empty.
  for el in mitems(deq): destroy(el)
  deq.count = 0
  deq.tail = deq.head

proc shrink*[T](deq: var Deque[T], fromFirst = 0, fromLast = 0) =
  ## Remove `fromFirst` elements from the front of the deque and
  ## `fromLast` elements from the back. If the supplied number of
  ## elements exceeds the total number of elements in the deque,
  ## the deque will remain empty.
  ##
  ## Any user defined destructors
  if fromFirst + fromLast > deq.count:
    clear(deq)
    return

  for i in 0 ..< fromFirst:
    destroy(deq.data[deq.head])
    deq.head = (deq.head + 1) and deq.mask

  for i in 0 ..< fromLast:
    destroy(deq.data[deq.tail])
    deq.tail = (deq.tail - 1) and deq.mask

  dec deq.count, fromFirst + fromLast

proc `$`*[T](deq: Deque[T]): string =
  ## Turn a deque into its string representation.
  result = "["
  for x in deq:
    if result.len > 1: result.add(", ")
    result.addQuoted(x)
  result.add("]")

type
  BinaryHeap*[T] = object
    nodes: seq[T]
    compare: proc(x,y:T):int
    popchunk: bool
proc newBinaryHeap*[T](compare:proc(x,y:T):int): BinaryHeap[T] =
  BinaryHeap[T](nodes:newSeq[T](),compare:compare,popchunk:false)
proc compareNode[T](h:BinaryHeap[T],i,j:int):int = h.compare(h.nodes[i],h.nodes[j])
proc size*[T](h:BinaryHeap[T]):int = h.nodes.len() - h.popchunk.int
proc items*[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T]):seq[T] =
  if h.popchunk : discard h.popimpl()
  return h.nodes
proc top*[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T]): T =
  if h.popchunk : discard h.popimpl()
  return h.nodes[0]
proc push*[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T],node:T):void =
  if h.popchunk :
    h.nodes[0] = node
    h.shiftdown()
  else: h.pushimpl(node)
proc pop*[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T]):T =
  if h.popchunk: discard h.popimpl()
  h.popchunk = true
  return h.nodes[0]

proc shiftdown[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T]): void =
  h.popchunk = false
  let size = h.nodes.len()
  var i = 0
  while true :
    let L = i * 2 + 1
    let R = i * 2 + 2
    if L >= size : break
    let child = if R < size and h.compareNode(R,L) <= 0 : R else: L
    if h.compareNode(i,child) <= 0: break
    swap(h.nodes[i],h.nodes[child])
    i = child

proc pushimpl[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T],node:T):void =
  h.nodes.add(node) #末尾に追加
  var i = h.nodes.len() - 1
  while i > 0: # 末尾から木を整形
    let parent = (i - 1) div 2
    if h.compare(h.nodes[parent],node) <= 0: break
    h.nodes[i] = h.nodes[parent]
    i = parent
  h.nodes[i] = node

proc popimpl[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T]):T =
  result = h.nodes[0] # rootと末尾を入れ替えて木を整形
  h.nodes[0] = h.nodes[^1]
  h.nodes.setLen(h.nodes.len() - 1)
  h.shiftdown()

from algorithm import SortOrder

type PairNode[T] = ref object
  element: T
  leftChild: PairNode[T]
  nextSibling: PairNode[T]
  prev: PairNode[T]

proc newPairNode[T](element: T): PairNode[T] =
  new result
  result.element = element



type PairingHeap[T] = ref object
  root: PairNode[T]
  cmp: proc (x, y: T): int

proc newPairingHeap*[T](order = SortOrder.Ascending): PairingHeap[T] =
  new result
  result.root = nil
  if order == Ascending:
    result.cmp = system.cmp
  else:
    result.cmp = proc (x, y: T): int = -system.cmp(x, y)

proc newPairingHeap*[T](cmp: proc (x, y: T): int {.closure.}): PairingHeap[T] =
  new result
  result.root = nil
  result.cmp = cmp

proc compareAndLink[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; first, second: var PairNode[T]) =
  if second.isNil:
    return

  if this.cmp(first.element, second.element) > 0:
    second.prev = first.prev
    first.prev = second
    first.nextSibling = second.leftChild
    if not first.nextSibling.isNil:
      first.nextSibling.prev = first
    second.leftChild = first
    first = second
  else:
    second.prev = first
    first.nextSibling = second.nextSibling
    if not first.nextSibling.isNil:
      first.nextSibling.prev = first
    second.nextSibling = first.leftChild
    if not second.nextSibling.isNil:
      second.nextSibling.prev = second
    first.leftChild = second

proc isEmpty[T](this: PairingHeap[T]): bool =
  this.root.isNil

proc insert*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; value: T): PairNode[T] {.discardable.} =
  result = newPairNode(value)
  if this.isEmpty:
    this.root = result
  else:
    this.compareAndLink(this.root, result)

proc findMin*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]): T =
  this.root.element

proc combineSiblings[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; firstSibling: var PairNode[T]): PairNode[T] =
  if firstSibling.nextSibling.isNil:
    return firstSibling

  var
    treeArray {.global.} = newSeq[PairNode[T]](5)
    numOfSiblings = 0
  while not firstSibling.isNil:
    if numOfSiblings == treeArray.len:
      treeArray.setLen(numOfSiblings * 2)
    treeArray[numOfSiblings] = firstSibling
    firstSibling.prev.nextSibling = nil
    firstSibling = firstSibling.nextSibling
    numOfSiblings.inc

  if numOfSiblings == treeArray.len:
    treeArray.setLen(numOfSiblings + 1)
  treeArray[numOfSiblings] = nil

  for i in countup(0, numOfSiblings - 2, 2):
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[i], treeArray[i + 1])

  if numOfSiblings mod 2 == 1:
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[numOfSiblings - 3], treeArray[numOfSiblings - 1])

  for j in countdown(numOfSiblings - numOfSiblings mod 2 - 2, 2, 2):
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[j - 2], treeArray[j])

  return treeArray[0]

proc deleteMinHelper[T](this: PairingHeap[T]) =
  if this.root.leftChild.isNil:
    this.root = nil
  else:
    this.root = this.combineSiblings(this.root.leftChild)

proc deleteMin*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]): T =
  if this.isEmpty:
    raise newException(ResourceExhaustedError, "The heap is empty")
  result = this.findMin
  this.deleteMinHelper

proc decrease*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; p: PairNode; newValue: T) =
  if p.element < newValue:
    return
  p.element = newValue

  if p != this.root:
    if not p.nextSibling.isNil:
      p.nextSibling.prev = p.prev

    if p.prev.leftChild == p:
      p.prev.leftChild = p.nextSibling
    else:
      p.prev.nextSibling = p.nextSibling
      p.nextSibling = nil
      compareAndLink(this.root, p)



type PriorityQueue*[T] = ref object
  heap: PairingHeap[T]
  size: Natural

proc newPriorityQueue*[T](order = SortOrder.Ascending): PriorityQueue[T] =
  new result
  result.heap = newPairingHeap[T](order)

proc newPriorityQueue*[T](cmp: proc (x, y: T): int): PriorityQueue[T] =
  new result
  result.heap = newPairingHeap[T](cmp)

proc isEmpty*[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): bool =
  this.heap.isEmpty

proc size*[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): Natural =
  this.size

proc top*[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  this.heap.findMin

proc push*[T](this: var PriorityQueue[T]; value: T) =
  this.heap.insert(value)
  this.size.inc

proc pop*[T](this: var PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  result = this.heap.deleteMin
  this.size.dec

proc meld*[T](this, other: var PriorityQueue[T]): PriorityQueue[T] {.discardable.} =
  ## The order of Two priority queues must be same.
  if other.isEmpty:
    return this
  if this.isEmpty:
    swap(this, other)
    return this

  this.heap.compareAndLink(this.heap.root, other.heap.root)
  this.size += other.size
  other.heap.root = nil
  other.size = 0
  return this

proc `$`[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): string =
  if this.isEmpty: return "[]"

  var copy = newPriorityQueue[T]()
  copy.deepCopy(this)
  result = "[" & $copy.pop
  while not copy.isEmpty:
    result.add(" " & $copy.pop)
  result.add("]")

  new result
  result.root = nil
  result.cmp = cmp

proc compareAndLink[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; first, second: var PairNode[T]) =
  if second.isNil:
    return

  if this.cmp(first.element, second.element) > 0:
    second.prev = first.prev
    first.prev = second
    first.nextSibling = second.leftChild
    if not first.nextSibling.isNil:
      first.nextSibling.prev = first
    second.leftChild = first
    first = second
  else:
    second.prev = first
    first.nextSibling = second.nextSibling
    if not first.nextSibling.isNil:
      first.nextSibling.prev = first
    second.nextSibling = first.leftChild
    if not second.nextSibling.isNil:
      second.nextSibling.prev = second
    first.leftChild = second

  this.root.isNil

  if firstSibling.nextSibling.isNil:
    return firstSibling

  var
    treeArray {.global.} = newSeq[PairNode[T]](5)
    numOfSiblings = 0
  while not firstSibling.isNil:
    if numOfSiblings == treeArray.len:
      treeArray.setLen(numOfSiblings * 2)
    treeArray[numOfSiblings] = firstSibling
    firstSibling.prev.nextSibling = nil
    firstSibling = firstSibling.nextSibling
    numOfSiblings.inc

  if numOfSiblings == treeArray.len:
    treeArray.setLen(numOfSiblings + 1)
  treeArray[numOfSiblings] = nil

  for i in countup(0, numOfSiblings - 2, 2):
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[i], treeArray[i + 1])

  if numOfSiblings mod 2 == 1:
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[numOfSiblings - 3], treeArray[numOfSiblings - 1])

  for j in countdown(numOfSiblings - numOfSiblings mod 2 - 2, 2, 2):
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[j - 2], treeArray[j])

  return treeArray[0]

  else:

  if p.element < newValue:
    return
  p.element = newValue

  if p != this.root:
    if not p.nextSibling.isNil:
      p.nextSibling.prev = p.prev

    if p.prev.leftChild == p:
      p.prev.leftChild = p.nextSibling
    else:
      p.prev.nextSibling = p.nextSibling
      p.nextSibling = nil
      compareAndLink(this.root, p)

proc push*[T](this: var PriorityQueue[T]; value: T) =

  this.size.inc

proc pop*[T](this: var PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  result = this.heap.deleteMin

  ## The order of Two priority queues must be same.
  if other.isEmpty:
    return this
  if this.isEmpty:
    swap(this, other)
    return this

  this.heap.compareAndLink(this.heap.root, other.heap.root)
  this.size += other.size
  other.heap.root = nil
  other.size = 0
  return this

  copy.deepCopy(this)
  result = "[" & $copy.pop

type
  BinaryHeap*[T] = object
    nodes: seq[T]
    compare: proc(x,y:T):int
    popchunk: bool
proc newBinaryHeap*[T](compare:proc(x,y:T):int): BinaryHeap[T] =
  BinaryHeap[T](nodes:newSeq[T](),compare:compare,popchunk:false)
proc compareNode[T](h:BinaryHeap[T],i,j:int):int = h.compare(h.nodes[i],h.nodes[j])
proc size*[T](h:BinaryHeap[T]):int = h.nodes.len() - h.popchunk.int
proc items*[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T]):seq[T] =
  if h.popchunk : discard h.popimpl()
  return h.nodes
proc top*[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T]): T =
  if h.popchunk : discard h.popimpl()
  return h.nodes[0]
proc push*[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T],node:T):void =
  if h.popchunk :
    h.nodes[0] = node
    h.shiftdown()
  else: h.pushimpl(node)
proc pop*[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T]):T =
  if h.popchunk: discard h.popimpl()
  h.popchunk = true
  return h.nodes[0]

proc shiftdown[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T]): void =
  h.popchunk = false
  let size = h.nodes.len()
  var i = 0
  while true :
    let L = i * 2 + 1
    let R = i * 2 + 2
    if L >= size : break
    let child = if R < size and h.compareNode(R,L) <= 0 : R else: L
    if h.compareNode(i,child) <= 0: break
    swap(h.nodes[i],h.nodes[child])
    i = child

proc pushimpl[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T],node:T):void =
  h.nodes.add(node) #末尾に追加
  var i = h.nodes.len() - 1
  while i > 0: # 末尾から木を整形
    let parent = (i - 1) div 2
    if h.compare(h.nodes[parent],node) <= 0: break
    h.nodes[i] = h.nodes[parent]
    i = parent
  h.nodes[i] = node

proc popimpl[T](h:var BinaryHeap[T]):T =
  result = h.nodes[0] # rootと末尾を入れ替えて木を整形
  h.nodes[0] = h.nodes[^1]
  h.nodes.setLen(h.nodes.len() - 1)
  h.shiftdown()

from algorithm import SortOrder

type PairNode[T] = ref object
  element: T
  leftChild: PairNode[T]
  nextSibling: PairNode[T]
  prev: PairNode[T]

proc newPairNode[T](element: T): PairNode[T] =
  new result
  result.element = element



type PairingHeap[T] = ref object
  root: PairNode[T]
  cmp: proc (x, y: T): int

proc newPairingHeap*[T](order = SortOrder.Ascending): PairingHeap[T] =
  new result
  result.root = nil
  if order == Ascending:
    result.cmp = system.cmp
  else:
    result.cmp = proc (x, y: T): int = -system.cmp(x, y)

proc newPairingHeap*[T](cmp: proc (x, y: T): int {.closure.}): PairingHeap[T] =
  new result
  result.root = nil
  result.cmp = cmp

proc compareAndLink[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; first, second: var PairNode[T]) =
  if second.isNil:
    return

  if this.cmp(first.element, second.element) > 0:
    second.prev = first.prev
    first.prev = second
    first.nextSibling = second.leftChild
    if not first.nextSibling.isNil:
      first.nextSibling.prev = first
    second.leftChild = first
    first = second
  else:
    second.prev = first
    first.nextSibling = second.nextSibling
    if not first.nextSibling.isNil:
      first.nextSibling.prev = first
    second.nextSibling = first.leftChild
    if not second.nextSibling.isNil:
      second.nextSibling.prev = second
    first.leftChild = second

proc isEmpty[T](this: PairingHeap[T]): bool =
  this.root.isNil

proc insert*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; value: T): PairNode[T] {.discardable.} =
  result = newPairNode(value)
  if this.isEmpty:
    this.root = result
  else:
    this.compareAndLink(this.root, result)

proc findMin*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]): T =
  this.root.element

proc combineSiblings[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; firstSibling: var PairNode[T]): PairNode[T] =
  if firstSibling.nextSibling.isNil:
    return firstSibling

  var
    treeArray {.global.} = newSeq[PairNode[T]](5)
    numOfSiblings = 0
  while not firstSibling.isNil:
    if numOfSiblings == treeArray.len:
      treeArray.setLen(numOfSiblings * 2)
    treeArray[numOfSiblings] = firstSibling
    firstSibling.prev.nextSibling = nil
    firstSibling = firstSibling.nextSibling
    numOfSiblings.inc

  if numOfSiblings == treeArray.len:
    treeArray.setLen(numOfSiblings + 1)
  treeArray[numOfSiblings] = nil

  for i in countup(0, numOfSiblings - 2, 2):
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[i], treeArray[i + 1])

  if numOfSiblings mod 2 == 1:
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[numOfSiblings - 3], treeArray[numOfSiblings - 1])

  for j in countdown(numOfSiblings - numOfSiblings mod 2 - 2, 2, 2):
    this.compareAndLink(treeArray[j - 2], treeArray[j])

  return treeArray[0]

proc deleteMinHelper[T](this: PairingHeap[T]) =
  if this.root.leftChild.isNil:
    this.root = nil
  else:
    this.root = this.combineSiblings(this.root.leftChild)

proc deleteMin*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]): T =
  if this.isEmpty:
    raise newException(ResourceExhaustedError, "The heap is empty")
  result = this.findMin
  this.deleteMinHelper

proc decrease*[T](this: PairingHeap[T]; p: PairNode; newValue: T) =
  if p.element < newValue:
    return
  p.element = newValue

  if p != this.root:
    if not p.nextSibling.isNil:
      p.nextSibling.prev = p.prev

    if p.prev.leftChild == p:
      p.prev.leftChild = p.nextSibling
    else:
      p.prev.nextSibling = p.nextSibling
      p.nextSibling = nil
      compareAndLink(this.root, p)



type PriorityQueue*[T] = ref object
  heap: PairingHeap[T]
  size: Natural

proc newPriorityQueue*[T](order = SortOrder.Ascending): PriorityQueue[T] =
  new result
  result.heap = newPairingHeap[T](order)

proc newPriorityQueue*[T](cmp: proc (x, y: T): int): PriorityQueue[T] =
  new result
  result.heap = newPairingHeap[T](cmp)

proc isEmpty*[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): bool =
  this.heap.isEmpty

proc size*[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): Natural =
  this.size

proc top*[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  this.heap.findMin

proc push*[T](this: var PriorityQueue[T]; value: T) =
  this.heap.insert(value)
  this.size.inc

proc pop*[T](this: var PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  result = this.heap.deleteMin
  this.size.dec

proc meld*[T](this, other: var PriorityQueue[T]): PriorityQueue[T] {.discardable.} =
  ## The order of Two priority queues must be same.
  if other.isEmpty:
    return this
  if this.isEmpty:
    swap(this, other)
    return this

  this.heap.compareAndLink(this.heap.root, other.heap.root)
  this.size += other.size
  other.heap.root = nil
  other.size = 0
  return this

proc `$`[T](this: PriorityQueue[T]): string =
  if this.isEmpty: return "[]"

  var copy = newPriorityQueue[T]()
  copy.deepCopy(this)
  result = "[" & $copy.pop
  while not copy.isEmpty:
    result.add(" " & $copy.pop)
  result.add("]")

from sequtils import newSeqWith
from algorithm import fill, reversed

type
  Edge* = tuple[to, cost: int]
  P = tuple[d, v: int]

type Dijkstra = ref object of RootObj
  G: seq[seq[Edge]] # グラフ (addEdge で辺を追加していく)
  dists*: seq[int] # start から各ノードへの最短距離
  prev*: seq[int] # 経路復元用

proc newDijkstra*(V: int): Dijkstra =
  result = Dijkstra(G: newSeqWith(V, newSeq[Edge]()), dists: newSeq[int](V), prev: newSeq[int](V))

proc addEdge*(this: var Dijkstra; f, t, c: int; fromCounts, toCounts: var seq[int]) =
  # f: from, t: to, c: cap
  this.G[f].add((to: t, cost: c))
  fromCounts[f].inc
  toCounts[t].inc

proc calc*(this: var Dijkstra; start: int) =
  var que = newPriorityQueue[P]()
  que.push((this.dists[start], start))
  this.dists.fill(int.high div 10)
  this.dists[start] = 0
  this.prev.fill(-1)

  var used = newSeq[bool](this.prev.len)

  while not que.isEmpty:
    let p = que.pop
    if used[p.v]:
      continue
    used[p.v] = true
    this.dists[p.v] = p.d
    for g in this.G[p.v]:
      if this.dists[g.to] > this.dists[p.v] + g.cost:
        this.dists[g.to] = this.dists[p.v] + g.cost
        this.prev[g.to] = p.v
        que.push((this.dists[g.to], g.to))

proc shortestPath*(this: Dijkstra; terminal: int): int =
  return this.dists[terminal]

proc getPath*(this: Dijkstra; start, terminal: int): seq[int] =
  result = newSeq[int]()
  var t = terminal
  while t != start:
    result.add(t)
    t = this.prev[t]
  result.add(t)
  return result.reversed

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, vertices):
        self.graph = dict()  # dictionary containing adjacency List
        self.V = vertices  # No. of vertices

    # # function to add an edge to graph
    # def add_edge(self, u: int, v: int):

    # function to add an edge to graph
    def add_edge(self, t):
        """
        Add edge

        :param t: edge()
        :return: None
        """
        a = self.graph.get(str(t[0]), [])
        a.append(t[1])
        self.graph[str(t[0])] = a

    def topological_sort(self):
        result = []
        visited = [False] * self.V

        for node in range(self.V):
            self.visit(node, visited, result)
        return result

    def visit(self, node, visited, result):
        if not visited[node]:
            visited[node] = True
            for out_node in self.graph.get(str(node), []):
                self.visit(out_node, visited, result)
            result.insert(0, node)

    def show_graph(self):
        for key in range(self.V):
            print('key', key)
            for value in self.graph.get(str(key), []):
                print('\t -> ', value)

    def is_parent(self, parent, child):
        return child in self.graph.get(str(parent), [])

def topological_sort(graph: dict) -> list:
    stack = deque([])
    visited = set()
    not_leaf = set(graph.keys())
    sort_list = []

    for i in graph.keys():
        if i in visited:
            continue
        stack.append(i)

        while stack:
            v = stack[-1]
            if v not in not_leaf:
                sort_list.append(stack.pop())
                visited.add(v)
                continue

            for next in graph[v]:
                if next not in visited:
                    stack.append(next)
                    break
            else:
                sort_list.append(stack.pop())
                visited.add(v)

    return sort_list[::-1]

# Width First Search (+ Distance)
def wfs_d(D, N, K):
    """
    D: 隣接行列(距離付き)
    N: ノード数
    K: 始点ノード
    """

    dfk = [-1] * (N + 1)
    dfk[K] = 0

    cps = [(K, 0)]
    r = [False] * (N + 1)
    r[K] = True
    while len(cps) != 0:
        n_cps = []
        for cp, cd in cps:
            for i, dfcp in enumerate(D[cp]):
                if dfcp != -1 and not r[i]:
                    dfk[i] = cd + dfcp
                    n_cps.append((i, cd + dfcp))
                    r[i] = True

        cps = n_cps[:]

    return dfk

def dfs_d(v, pre, dist):
    """
    v:  現在のノード
    pre: １つ前のノード
    dist: 現在の距離

    以下は別途用意する
    D: 隣接リスト(行列ではない)
    D_dfs_d: dfs_d関数で用いる，始点ノードから見た距離リスト
    """

    global D
    global D_dfs_d

    D_dfs_d[v] = dist

    for next_v, d in D[v]:
        if next_v != pre:
            dfs_d(next_v, v, dist + d)

    return

def comb(n, r):
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n

    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]

    for p in range(2, r + 1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p - 1, r, p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot

    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])

    return result

def bisearch(L, target):
    low = 0
    high = len(L) - 1
    
    while low <= high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        guess = L[mid]
        if guess == target:
            return True
        elif guess < target:
            low = mid + 1
        elif guess > target:
            high = mid - 1
    if guess != target:
        return False

# Width First Search (+ Distance)
def wfs_d(D, N, K):
    """
    D: 隣接行列(距離付き)
    N: ノード数
    K: 始点ノード
    """

    dfk = [-1] * (N + 1)
    dfk[K] = 0

    cps = [(K, 0)]
    r = [False] * (N + 1)
    r[K] = True
    while len(cps) != 0:
        n_cps = []
        for cp, cd in cps:
            for i, dfcp in enumerate(D[cp]):
                if dfcp != -1 and not r[i]:
                    dfk[i] = cd + dfcp
                    n_cps.append((i, cd + dfcp))
                    r[i] = True

        cps = n_cps[:]

    return dfk


# Depth First Search (+Distance)
def dfs_d(v, pre, dist):
    """
    v:  現在のノード
    pre: １つ前のノード
    dist: 現在の距離

    以下は別途用意する
    D: 隣接リスト(行列ではない)
    D_dfs_d: dfs_d関数で用いる，始点ノードから見た距離リスト
    """

    global D
    global D_dfs_d

    D_dfs_d[v] = dist

    for next_v, d in D[v]:
        if next_v != pre:
            dfs_d(next_v, v, dist + d)

    return

def comb(n, r):
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n

    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]

    for p in range(2, r + 1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p - 1, r, p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot

    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])

    return result

def bisearch(L, target):
    low = 0
    high = len(L) - 1
    
    while low <= high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        guess = L[mid]
        if guess == target:
            return True
        elif guess < target:
            low = mid + 1
        elif guess > target:
            high = mid - 1
    if guess != target:
        return False

    def add_edge(self, t):
        """
        Add edge

        :param t: edge()
        :return: None
        """
        a = self.graph.get(str(t[0]), [])
        a.append(t[1])
        self.graph[str(t[0])] = a

    def topological_sort(self):
        result = []
        visited = [False] * self.V

        for node in range(self.V):
            self.visit(node, visited, result)
        return result

    def visit(self, node, visited, result):
        if not visited[node]:
            visited[node] = True
            for out_node in self.graph.get(str(node), []):
                self.visit(out_node, visited, result)
            result.insert(0, node)

    def show_graph(self):
        for key in range(self.V):
            print('key', key)
            for value in self.graph.get(str(key), []):
                print('\t -> ', value)

    def is_parent(self, parent, child):
        return child in self.graph.get(str(parent), [])

    def get_root(self) -> int:
        result = [False] * self.V
        for node in range(self.V):
            for dist in self.graph.get(str(node), []):
                result[dist] = True
        for i, each in enumerate(result):
            if each is False:
                return i

def main():
    n, m = map(int, input().split())
    G = [[] for i in range(n+1)]
    Edge = []
    is_root = [True]*(n+1)
    
    for _ in range(n+m-1):

        Edge.append((x, y))
        is_root[y] = False

    #determine root
    root = -1
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        if is_root[i] == True:
            root = i
            break

    que = [(0, root)]
    heapq.heapify(que)
    #dijkstra
    dis = [0]*(n+1)
    while que:
        cost, node = heapq.heappop(que)
        if dis[node] < cost:continue        
        for c in G[node]:
            if dis[c] > cost - 1:
                dis[c] = cost - 1
                heapq.heappush(que,(cost - 1, c))

    par = [0]*(n+1)

    for x, y in Edge:
        if dis[y] + 1 == dis[x]:
            par[y] = x

    for i in range(1, n+1):
        print(par[i])

    return

class Graph(): #directed
    def __init__(self, n, edge, indexed=1):
        self.n = n
        self.graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.rev = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.deg = [0 for _ in range(n)]
        for e in edge:
            self.graph[e[0] - indexed].append(e[1] - indexed)
            self.rev[e[1] - indexed].append(e[0] - indexed)
            self.deg[e[1] - indexed] += 1

    def topological_sort(self):
        deg = self.deg[:]
        res = [i for i in range(self.n) if deg[i] == 0]
        queue = deque(res)
        used = [False for _ in range(self.n)]
        while queue:
            node = queue.popleft()
            for adj in self.graph[node]:
                deg[adj] -= 1
                if deg[adj] == 0:
                    queue.append(adj)
                    res.append(adj)
        return res

def topological_sort(N: int, edges: list) -> list:
    # ここからトポロジカルソート準備
    incnts = [0] * N
    outnodes = [[] for i in range(N)]
    for i in range(len(edges)):
        # 流入するノード数
        incnts[edges[i][1]] += 1
        # 流出先ノードのリスト
        outnodes[edges[i][0]].append(edges[i][1])
    # 流入ノード数が0であるノードのセットS
    S = set()
    for i in range(N):
        if incnts[i] == 0:
            S.add(i)

    # ここからトポロジカルソート
    L = []
    # 暫定セットが空になるまでループ
    i = 0
    while S:
        # 暫定セットから結果リストへ1つ入れる
        L.append(S.pop())
        # 確定させたノードから流出するノードでループ
        for node in outnodes[L[-1]]:
            # 流入ノード数を1減らす
            incnts[node] -= 1
            # 流入ノードが0なら暫定セットへ
            if incnts[node] == 0:
                S.add(node)
        # 各頂点が何番目かを保持しておく
        ts2[L[-1]] = i
        i += 1
    # ソートされた頂点のリストを返却
    return L

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, vertices):
        self.graph = defaultdict(list)  # dictionary containing adjacency List
        self.V = vertices  # No. of vertices

    # function to add an edge to graph
    def add_edge(self, u: int, v: int):
        """
        Add edge

        :param u: parent
        :param v: child
        :return:  None
        """
        self.graph[str(u)].append(v)

    def add_edge(self, t: tuple):
        """
        Add edge

        :param t: edge()
        :return: None
        """
        self.graph[str(t[0])].append(t[1])

    def topological_sort(self) -> list:
        result = []
        visited = [False] * self.V

        for node in range(self.V):
            self.visit(node, visited, result)

        return result

    def visit(self, node: int, visited: list, result: list):
        if not visited[node]:
            visited[node] = True
            for out_node in self.graph.get(str(node), []):
                self.visit(out_node, visited, result)
            result.insert(0, node)

# Width First Search (+ Distance)
def wfs_d(D, N, K):
    """
    D: 隣接行列(距離付き)
    N: ノード数
    K: 始点ノード
    """

    dfk = [-1] * (N + 1)
    dfk[K] = 0

    cps = [(K, 0)]
    r = [False] * (N + 1)
    r[K] = True
    while len(cps) != 0:
        n_cps = []
        for cp, cd in cps:
            for i, dfcp in enumerate(D[cp]):
                if dfcp != -1 and not r[i]:
                    dfk[i] = cd + dfcp
                    n_cps.append((i, cd + dfcp))
                    r[i] = True

        cps = n_cps[:]

    return dfk


# Depth First Search (+Distance)
def dfs_d(v, pre, dist):
    """
    v:  現在のノード
    pre: １つ前のノード
    dist: 現在の距離

    以下は別途用意する
    D: 隣接リスト(行列ではない)
    D_dfs_d: dfs_d関数で用いる，始点ノードから見た距離リスト
    """

    global D
    global D_dfs_d

    D_dfs_d[v] = dist

    for next_v, d in D[v]:
        if next_v != pre:
            dfs_d(next_v, v, dist + d)

    return


def sigma(N):

def comb(n, r):
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n

    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]

    for p in range(2, r + 1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p - 1, r, p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot

    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])

    return result

def bisearch(L, target):
    low = 0
    high = len(L) - 1
    
    while low <= high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        guess = L[mid]
        if guess == target:
            return True
        elif guess < target:
            low = mid + 1
        elif guess > target:
            high = mid - 1
    if guess != target:
        return False

def solve(N, M, AB):
    is_root = [1] * N
    parents = collections.defaultdict(list)
    children = collections.defaultdict(list)

    def bfs(root):
        distance = [-1] * N
        real_parent = {}
        que = [(root, -1, 0)]
        while que:
            n, p, d = que.pop(-1)
            if distance[n] < d:
                distance[n] = d
                real_parent[n] = p
                for c in children[n]:
                    que.append((c, n, d + 1))
        return real_parent

        parents[b].append(a)
        children[a].append(b)
        is_root[b] = 0
    root = is_root.index(1)

    real_parent = bfs(root)
    return [real_parent[i] + 1 for i in range(N)]

# Width First Search (+ Distance)
def wfs_d(D, N, K):
    """
    D: 隣接行列(距離付き)
    N: ノード数
    K: 始点ノード
    """

    dfk = [-1] * (N + 1)
    dfk[K] = 0

    cps = [(K, 0)]
    r = [False] * (N + 1)
    r[K] = True
    while len(cps) != 0:
        n_cps = []
        for cp, cd in cps:
            for i, dfcp in enumerate(D[cp]):
                if dfcp != -1 and not r[i]:
                    dfk[i] = cd + dfcp
                    n_cps.append((i, cd + dfcp))
                    r[i] = True

        cps = n_cps[:]

    return dfk


# Depth First Search (+Distance)
def dfs_d(v, pre, dist):
    """
    v:  現在のノード
    pre: １つ前のノード
    dist: 現在の距離

    以下は別途用意する
    D: 隣接リスト(行列ではない)
    D_dfs_d: dfs_d関数で用いる，始点ノードから見た距離リスト
    """

    global D
    global D_dfs_d

    D_dfs_d[v] = dist

    for next_v, d in D[v]:
        if next_v != pre:
            dfs_d(next_v, v, dist + d)

    return

def comb(n, r):
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n

    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]

    for p in range(2, r + 1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p - 1, r, p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot

    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])

    return result

def bisearch(L, target):
    low = 0
    high = len(L) - 1
    
    while low <= high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        guess = L[mid]
        if guess == target:
            return True
        elif guess < target:
            low = mid + 1
        elif guess > target:
            high = mid - 1
    if guess != target:
        return False

class DiGraph:
    def __init__(self, n, decrement=True, destroy=False, edges=[]):
        """
        incs[p]: 頂点 p に流入するリンク数
        """
        self.n = n
        self.decrement = decrement
        self.destroy = destroy
        self.edges = [set() for _ in range(self.n)]
        self.incs = [0]*self.n
        for x, y in edges:
            self.add_edge(x,y)

    def add_edge(self, x, y):
        if self.decrement:
            x -= 1
            y -= 1
        self.edges[x].add(y)
        self.incs[y] += 1

    def topological_sort(self):
        next_set = {p for p, inc in enumerate(self.incs) if inc == 0}
        res = []
        while next_set:
            p = next_set.pop()
            res.append(p+self.decrement)
            for q in self.edges[p]:
                self.incs[q] -= 1
                if self.incs[q] == 0:
                    next_set.add(q)
        if len(res) == self.n:
            return res
        else:
            return -1

    def draw(self):
        """
        :return: グラフを可視化
        """
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        import networkx as nx

        G = nx.DiGraph()
        for x in range(self.n):
            for y in self.edges[x]:
                G.add_edge(x + self.decrement, y + self.decrement)

        pos = nx.spring_layout(G)
        nx.draw_networkx(G, pos)
        plt.axis("off")
        plt.show()

def npk(n, k, kaijyo):
    if k == 0 or k == n:
        return n % MOD
    return (kaijyo[n] * divide(kaijyo[n-k])) % MOD


def kaijyo(n):
    ret = [1]
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        ret.append((ret[-1] * i)% MOD)
    return ret

    cnt = [0]*V
    s = []
    for i in range(V):
        for j in to[i]:
            cnt[j] += 1
    Q = [i for i in range(V) if cnt[i]==0]
    while len(Q) > 0:
        i = Q[0]
        del Q[0]
        s.append(i)
        for k in to[i]:
            cnt[k] -= 1
            if cnt[k] == 0:
                Q.append(k)
    return s

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, vertices):
        self.graph = dict()  # dictionary containing adjacency List

    # function to add an edge to graph

    def add_edge(self, t):
        """
        Add edge

        :param t: edge()
        :return: None
        """
        a = self.graph.get(str(t[0]), [])
        a.append(t[1])
        self.graph[str(t[0])] = a

    def topological_sort(self):
        result = []
        visited = [False] * self.V

        for node in range(self.V):
            self.visit(node, visited, result)
        return result

    def visit(self, node, visited, result):
        if not visited[node]:
            visited[node] = True
            for out_node in self.graph.get(str(node), []):
                self.visit(out_node, visited, result)
            result.insert(0, node)

    def show_graph(self):
        for key in self.graph:
            print(key)
            for value in self.graph[key]:
                print('\t -> {value}')

    def is_parent(self, parent, child):
        return child in self.graph.get(str(parent), [])

# Class to represent a graph
class Graph:
    def __init__(self, vertices):
        self.graph = defaultdict(list)  # dictionary containing adjacency List
        self.V = vertices  # No. of vertices

    # function to add an edge to graph
    def add_edge(self, u: int, v: int):
        """
        Add edge

        :param u: parent
        :param v: child
        :return:  None
        """
        self.graph[str(u)].append(v)

    def add_edge(self, t: tuple):
        """
        Add edge

        :param t: edge()
        :return: None
        """
        self.graph[str(t[0])].append(t[1])

    # A recursive function used by topologicalSort
    def topological_sort_util(self, v, visited, stack):

        # Mark the current node as visited.
        visited[v] = True

        # Recur for all the vertices adjacent to this vertex
        for i in self.graph[v]:
            if visited[i] is False:
                self.topological_sort_util(i, visited, stack)

            # Push current vertex to stack which stores result
        stack.insert(0, v)

    # The function to do Topological Sort. It uses recursive
    # topologicalSortUtil()
    def topological_sort(self) -> list:
        # Mark all the vertices as not visited
        visited = [False] * self.V
        stack = []

        # Call the recursive helper function to store Topological
        # Sort starting from all vertices one by one
        for i in range(self.V):
            if visited[i] is False:
                self.topological_sort_util(i, visited, stack)

            # Print contents of stack
        print(stack)
        return stack

    def show_graph(self):
        for key in self.graph:
            print(key)
            for value in self.graph[key]:
                print(f'\t -> {value}')

    def is_parent(self, parent, child):
        return child in self.graph.get(str(parent), [])

# Width First Search (+ Distance)
def wfs_d(D, N, K):
    """
    D: 隣接行列(距離付き)
    N: ノード数
    K: 始点ノード
    """

    dfk = [-1] * (N + 1)
    dfk[K] = 0

    cps = [(K, 0)]
    r = [False] * (N + 1)
    r[K] = True
    while len(cps) != 0:
        n_cps = []
        for cp, cd in cps:
            for i, dfcp in enumerate(D[cp]):
                if dfcp != -1 and not r[i]:
                    dfk[i] = cd + dfcp
                    n_cps.append((i, cd + dfcp))
                    r[i] = True

        cps = n_cps[:]

    return dfk


# Depth First Search (+Distance)
def dfs_d(v, pre, dist):
    """
    v:  現在のノード
    pre: １つ前のノード
    dist: 現在の距離

    以下は別途用意する
    D: 隣接リスト(行列ではない)
    D_dfs_d: dfs_d関数で用いる，始点ノードから見た距離リスト
    """

    global D
    global D_dfs_d

    D_dfs_d[v] = dist

    for next_v, d in D[v]:
        if next_v != pre:
            dfs_d(next_v, v, dist + d)

    return

def comb(n, r):
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n

    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]

    for p in range(2, r + 1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p - 1, r, p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot

    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])

    return result

def bisearch(L, target):
    low = 0
    high = len(L) - 1
    
    while low <= high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        guess = L[mid]
        if guess == target:
            return True
        elif guess < target:
            low = mid + 1
        elif guess > target:
            high = mid - 1
    if guess != target:
        return False

def topological_sort(V, E_in, E_from):
    '''
    V:N(node)
    E_from:
    E_in:
    '''

    # count num of pointed nodes for each nodes
    parent = [0]*V
    cnt = [0]*V
    Q = []
    for v in range(V):
        cnt[v] = len(E_in[v])
        if cnt[v] == 0:
            Q.append(v)

    while Q:
        del_node = Q.pop()
        for j in E_from[del_node]:
            cnt[j] -= 1
            if cnt[j] == 0:
                Q.append(j)
                parent[j] = del_node+1

    return parent

def topological_sort(V, E_in, E_from):
    '''
    V:N(node)
    E_from:
    E_in:
    '''

    # count num of pointed nodes for each nodes
    cnt = [0]*V
    Q = []
    for v in range(V):
        cnt[v] = len(E_in[v])
        if cnt[v] == 0:
            Q.append(v)

    ret = []
    while Q:
        del_node = Q.pop()
        ret.append(del_node)
        for j in E_from[del_node]:
            cnt[j] -= 1
            if cnt[j] == 0:
                Q.append(j)

    return ret

import sys

class DiGraph:
    def __init__(self, n, decrement=True, destroy=False, edges=[]):
        """
        incs[p]: 頂点 p に流入するリンク数
        """
        self.n = n
        self.decrement = decrement
        self.destroy = destroy
        self.edges = [set() for _ in range(self.n)]
        self.incs = [0]*self.n
        for x, y in edges:
            self.add_edge(x,y)

    def add_edge(self, x, y):
        if self.decrement:
            x -= 1
            y -= 1
        self.edges[x].add(y)
        self.incs[y] += 1

    def topological_sort(self):
        next_set = {p for p, inc in enumerate(self.incs) if inc == 0}
        res = []
        while next_set:
            p = next_set.pop()
            res.append(p+self.decrement)
            for q in self.edges[p]:
                self.incs[q] -= 1
                if self.incs[q] == 0:
                    next_set.add(q)
        if len(res) == self.n:
            return res
        else:
            return -1

    def draw(self):
        """
        :return: グラフを可視化
        """
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        import networkx as nx

        G = nx.DiGraph()
        for x in range(self.n):
            for y in self.edges[x]:
                G.add_edge(x + self.decrement, y + self.decrement)

        pos = nx.spring_layout(G)
        nx.draw_networkx(G, pos)
        plt.axis("off")
        plt.show()

import sys

class DiGraph:
    def __init__(self, n, decrement=True, destroy=False, edges=[]):
        """
        incs[p]: 頂点 p に流入するリンク数
        """
        self.n = n
        self.decrement = decrement
        self.destroy = destroy
        self.edges = [set() for _ in range(self.n)]
        self.incs = [0]*self.n
        for x, y in edges:
            self.add_edge(x,y)

    def add_edge(self, x, y):
        if self.decrement:
            x -= 1
            y -= 1
        self.edges[x].add(y)
        self.incs[y] += 1

    def topological_sort(self):
        next_set = {p for p, inc in enumerate(self.incs) if inc == 0}
        while next_set:
            p = next_set.pop()
            yield p+self.decrement
            for q in self.edges[p]:
                self.incs[q] -= 1
                if self.incs[q] == 0:
                    next_set.add(q)

    def draw(self):
        """
        :return: グラフを可視化
        """
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        import networkx as nx

        G = nx.DiGraph()
        for x in range(self.n):
            for y in self.edges[x]:
                G.add_edge(x + self.decrement, y + self.decrement)

        pos = nx.spring_layout(G)
        nx.draw_networkx(G, pos)
        plt.axis("off")
        plt.show()

# UnionFind
class UnionFind:
    # 負: ルートで値は木の深さを表す
    # 正: 子で値は次のノードを表す
    def __init__(self, size: int) -> None:
        self.nodes = [-1] * size  # 初期状態では全てのノードがルート

    def get_root(self, x: int) -> int:
        if self.nodes[x] < 0:
            return x
        else:
            self.nodes[x] = self.get_root(self.nodes[x])
            return self.nodes[x]

    def unite(self, x: int, y: int) -> None:
        root_x, root_y = self.get_root(x), self.get_root(y)
        if root_x != root_y:
            if self.nodes[root_x] != self.nodes[root_y]:  # グラフの高さが異なる場合
                # 木のランクが高い方のルートに併合させる
                # 併合後にランクの変動はない
                if self.nodes[root_x] < self.nodes[root_y]:
                    self.nodes[root_y] = root_x
                else:
                    self.nodes[root_x] = root_y
            else:
                # ランクが等しい木同士を併合させるので
                # 併合後は木のランクが1つ上がる
                self.nodes[root_x] += -1
                self.nodes[root_y] = root_x

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, vertices):
        self.graph = {}  # dictionary containing adjacency List
        self.V = vertices  # No. of vertices

    # function to add an edge to graph
    # def add_edge(self, u: int, v: int):

    def add_edge(self, t):
        """
        Add edge

        :param t: edge()
        :return: None
        """
        self.graph[str(t[0])] = self.graph.get(str(t[0]), []).append(t[1])

    def topological_sort(self):
        result = []
        visited = [False] * self.V

        for node in range(self.V):
            self.visit(node, visited, result)
        return result

    def visit(self, node, visited, result):
        if not visited[node]:
            visited[node] = True
            for out_node in self.graph.get(str(node), []):
                self.visit(out_node, visited, result)
            result.insert(0, node)

    def show_graph(self):
        for key in self.graph:
            print(key)
            for value in self.graph[key]:
                print(f'\t -> {value}')

    def is_parent(self, parent, child):
        return child in self.graph.get(str(parent), [])

from heapq import*

def Dijkstra(G: list, source=0):
	INF = float("inf")
	V = len(G)
	D = [INF] * V
	D[source] = 0
	vis = [False] * V
	H = [(0, source)]
	while H:
		dist, cur = heappop(H)
		if vis[cur]:
			continue
		vis[cur] = True
		for nxt, cost in G[cur]:
			t = dist + cost
			if D[nxt] > t:
				D[nxt] = t
				heappush(H, (t, nxt))
	return D

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, vertices):
        self.graph = defaultdict(list)  # dictionary containing adjacency List
        self.V = vertices  # No. of vertices

    # function to add an edge to graph
    # def add_edge(self, u: int, v: int):
    #     """
    #     Add edge
    #
    #     :param u: parent
    #     :param v: child
    #     :return:  None
    #     """
    #     self.graph[str(u)].append(v)

    def add_edge(self, t):
        """
        Add edge

        :param t: edge()
        :return: None
        """
        self.graph[str(t[0])].append(t[1])

    def topological_sort(self):
        result = []
        visited = [False] * self.V

        for node in range(self.V):
            self.visit(node, visited, result)
        return result

    def visit(self, node, visited, result):
        if not visited[node]:
            visited[node] = True
            for out_node in self.graph.get(str(node), []):
                self.visit(out_node, visited, result)
            result.insert(0, node)

    def show_graph(self):
        for key in self.graph:
            print(key)
            for value in self.graph[key]:
                print(f'\t -> {value}')

    def is_parent(self, parent, child):
        return child in self.graph.get(str(parent), [])

from collections import deque
def topological_sort(graph, nodes):
    """

    Prameters
    ---------
    graph: list, [[parent, child], ...]
        graph[i][0]からgraph[i][1]へ
        コード上はv1が親ノード,v2が子ノード

    nodes : list
        全ノードのリスト

    Returns
    -------
    res : list
        トポロジカルソートされたノード
        インデックスが小さい方が親ノード側
    """
    outs = {i: [] for i in nodes}
    ins = {i: 0 for i in nodes}
    for v1, v2 in graph:
        outs[v1].append(v2)
        ins[v2] += 1

    queue = deque(i for i in nodes if ins[i] == 0)
    res = []
    while queue:
        v1 = queue.popleft()
        res.append(v1)
        for v2 in outs[v1]:
            ins[v2] -= 1
            if ins[v2] == 0:
                queue.append(v2)
    return res

def topological_sort(V, E_in, E_from):
    '''
    V:N(node)
    E_from:
    E_in:
    '''

    # count num of pointed nodes for each nodes
    cnt = [0]*V
    Q = []
    for v in range(V):
        cnt[v] = len(E_in[v])
        if cnt[v] == 0:
            Q.append(v)

    ret = []
    while Q:
        del_node = Q.pop()
        ret.append(del_node)
        for j in E_from[del_node]:
            cnt[j] -= 1
            if cnt[j] == 0:
                Q.append(j)

    return ret

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, vertices):
        self.graph = defaultdict(list)  # dictionary containing adjacency List
        self.V = vertices  # No. of vertices

    # function to add an edge to graph
    # def add_edge(self, u: int, v: int):
    #     """
    #     Add edge
    #
    #     :param u: parent
    #     :param v: child
    #     :return:  None
    #     """
    #     self.graph[str(u)].append(v)

    def add_edge(self, t: tuple):
        """
        Add edge

        :param t: edge()
        :return: None
        """
        self.graph[str(t[0])].append(t[1])

    def topological_sort(self) -> list:
        result = []
        visited = [False] * self.V

        for node in range(self.V):
            self.visit(node, visited, result)

        return result

    def visit(self, node: int, visited: list, result: list):
        if not visited[node]:
            visited[node] = True
            for out_node in self.graph.get(str(node), []):
                self.visit(out_node, visited, result)
            result.insert(0, node)

    def show_graph(self):
        for key in self.graph:
            print(key)
            for value in self.graph[key]:
                print(f'\t -> {value}')

    def is_parent(self, parent, child):
        return child in self.graph.get(str(parent), [])

fn height(graph: &Vec<Vec<usize>>, h: &mut Vec<usize>, u: usize) -> usize {
    if h[u] != INF {
        return h[u];
    }
    h[u] = graph[u]
        .iter()
        .map(|&v| height(graph, h, v) + 1)
        .max()
        .unwrap();
    h[u]
}

fn decode(v: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut ret = vec![];
    let mut buf = 0;
    let mut tbl = vec![64; 256];
    for i in 0..64 { tbl[TBL[i] as usize] = i as u8; }
    for (i, c) in v.bytes().filter_map(|c| { let c = tbl[c as usize]; if c < 64 { Some(c) } else { None } }).enumerate() {
        match i % 4 {
            0 => buf = c << 2,
            1 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 4); buf = c << 4; }
            2 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 2); buf = c << 6; }
            3 => ret.push(buf | c),
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
    }
    ret
}
